source_title: huggingface/paperswithcode: This repository hosts the code of Papers with Code, which tracks trending AI research with code, datasets and leaderboards. - GitHub
source_excerpt:
Papers with Code makes open AI research and its artifacts accessible: papers, code, models, datasets, tasks, methods, and benchmark leaderboards. It recreates the original paperswithcode.com, which Meta retired in 2025, and keeps it up to date with automated imports from Hugging Face, arXiv, GitHub, and public leaderboards.
Live site: https://paperswithcode.co
Paper catalog. arXiv and external papers with official code, project pages, Hugging Face models, datasets, and Spaces, plus thumbnails, TL;DRs, lineage, and a Markdown reader.
Taxonomy. Browsable tasks, methods, datasets, frameworks, conferences, organizations, and authors, with trending views.
Leaderboards. Paper-native evaluation results on benchmarks, plus scheduled syncs of external leaderboards.
Search. Hybrid lexical ( pg_trgm ) and semantic ( pgvector ) paper retrieval.
Public API. A REST API under /api/v1/ that stays compatible with the original Papers with Code API client . OpenAPI docs are served at /docs .
Research chat (optional). An assistant grounded in the catalog through the Papers with Code MCP tools.
Curation automation. Scheduled jobs and agent workflows import daily papers, link tasks and methods, refresh stars and citations, and propose evaluations.
